prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Adoption visual enhancements (compact photo grids, style selectors, pre-upload inspection), split-view path layouts, session safeguard hints, clear desktop control hints/copy, compact welcome dashboards, post-waiting auth reorders, and waiting tip carousels/readiness hints.
Hurt performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners, pre-adoption photo prep screens, pre/post-certificate sign-in reorders, path speed callouts/headlines, story scroll intros, and instant activation incentives.
No clear effect seen: Audio and background notifications, adoption incentive badges, account persistence verification flows, waiting progress overlays/checklists, and carousel or two-column path layouts.
Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspection, photo quality callouts, compact welcome dashboards, clear desktop control copy, post-waiting auth reorders, path reassurance hints, and session safeguard hints.
Predictions were too high: Desktop finish redesigns, preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in stage shifts/reorders, instant activation incentives, and all tests resulting in negative performance or no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, new_flow] Previous Pet Profile Retrieval Sign-In Flow: Add cloud save status callouts and profile recovery hints on the sign-in screen to assure returning users their pets are safe. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Compact Pet Identity Stage Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate layout into a compact stage layout with clear identity confirmation. (why: Adoption has 94.8% conversion; compact visual enhancements in adoption screens consistently improve user engagement and progression.)
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Environment Launch Readiness Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop launch verification screen immediately after generation waiting to verify screen rendering. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, while support reports pets occasionally failing to appear on desktop.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Path Decision Trait Guidance Hint: Display a explicit hint on the choose_path screen explaining that both Preset and Custom paths provide full desktop pet features. (why: Choose path has a high mean completion time of 514s, indicating user hesitation between selection options.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Taskbar Visibility Guidance Copy: Update the home intro headline and body text to detail taskbar tray controls and pet visibility toggles. (why: Finish step dropoff is high (72.0% conversion) and support receives multiple issues regarding pet visibility and controls.)
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Readiness Background Progress Callout: Enable time estimates and add background processing reassurance hints to the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, causing uncertainty while waiting for generation.)
6: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Style Safety Hint: Add clear photo preparation quality guidance text on the upload_photos screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Session Recovery Reassurance Copy: Reframe the sign-in headline and body copy to clearly communicate profile session persistence. (why: 8 support emails were caused by confusion around missing pets or resetting profiles after signing in.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Compact Split View Path Selection Layout: Switch the choose path screen layout to compact to reduce visual clutter during path choice. (why: Choose path mean duration of 514s suggests users benefit from a faster, more condensed decision view.)
